name: Michael Kemps
office: City of Palos Verdes Estates, Member of the City Council

items.text: Michael Kemps is the mayor of Palos Verdes Estates and is serving his second term on the City Council. He founded the technology-services company Innovative Computing Systems in 1989 and is its chief executive officer. He served on the advisory board of Premier Bank of Palos Verdes prior to its acquisition.

sentences.text: Michael Kemps is the mayor of Palos Verdes Estates and is serving his second term on the City Council.
He founded the technology-services company Innovative Computing Systems in 1989 and is its chief executive officer.
He served on the advisory board of Premier Bank of Palos Verdes prior to its acquisition.

items.text: In 2026 he supported placing a parcel tax measure on the ballot to maintain funding for the Police Department and continue paying down the city's pension debt. He also backs area-wide disaster preparedness collaboration.
